thread:
tess: Quick heads-up: CI alerted that cosign started failing for several base-image builds after the scheduled KMS rotation last night.
priya: Which images? any CVEs?
tess: Affected tags: redwood/base-compact:2026-04-10 and redwood/runtime-lite:2026-04-10. No new CVEs reported, it's a signing/access problem.
omar: Looking at logs: cosign error `permission denied` when accessing cryptoKeyVersions/2. Rotation created v3 and the IAM binding wasn't reapplied.
marta: I rolled rotation via infra-runner. I thought the rotation script reattached bindings automatically but it skipped due to a transient API error. Filing CL-4720.
priya: Mitigation plan: 1) quarantine affected tags from prod pulls 2) reattach signer principal to v3 with narrow condition 3) re-sign tags (or rebuild minimal if needed) 4) enable extra post-rotation verification run.
tess: Agreed. Please add a temporary audit sink for KMS writes for 7d and tag the infra-change.
marta: Done: CL-4721 created; KMS audit sink enabled to project logs-archive for 7d.
omar: Quarantine applied: registry denies prod pulls for both tags.
priya: After binding attach, cosign sign retries succeeded. Verified signatures for both tags. `cosign verify` -> Verified OK.
tess: Canaries rolling out to staging. Watch for any start-up errors.
priya: Staging canaries healthy 12m. Promoting to canary-prod.
marta: I'll follow up on CL-4720 to add retry and verification steps in rotation script so we don't silently lose bindings.
sec-bot: Incident note: root cause = rotation script missing a retry path for IAM attach; impact = temporary signer outage; mitigation = reattach + quarantine + audit sink. Recommended: rotation pre-check and post-check automation.
tess: Filing PM ticket PM-812 to capture follow-ups and schedule a 20-min retro. Closing thread.
